measurement: Native GDS and OA device unions. Wire proxy sums half the perimeter of net-labelled top-cell metal unions on M1–M6. Both filled macros use distributed supply xRC. Peak values are taken at one MOS diffusion per rail at 14 sites with ideal macro port supplies.
